name: Wooden Beer and Treat Case
description:
KEY FEATURES

 

  • Premium Material: Made from 5mm thick wooden panels, sturdy, natural texture ideal for a warm, rustic aesthetic, and handcrafted charm. The wooden surface is finely sanded and treated to ensure long-lasting use while maintaining a natural aesthetic.

 

  • Sizes and Dimensions: Overall Dimensions (LxW) Approx. 9.31 x 6.48 inches ~ 23.64 x 15.49 cm and Height Approx. 8.51 inches ~ 21.62 cm (including handle)

- Product Construction: The case is divided into two main sections: One side features 3 separate slots, designed to fit cans or bottles of beer (330ml–500ml) securely in place.

- The other side is an open compartment without dividers — perfect for snacks, fruits, small gifts, or any other personal items.

- Please note: due to the relatively thin material, its weight capacity is limited, and it is best recommended for decorative or gift purposes rather than heavy-duty transport.

 

  • Printing Technology: Features high-quality UV printing technology, delivering vibrant, sharp, and fade-resistant images or personalized messages. Perfect for adding names, logos, or holiday graphics with excellent detail and color accuracy.

 

  • Functionality: Designed for both presentation and utility, this wooden case serves multiple purposes:

-  Gift box for beer lovers

-  Reusable storage crate for snacks, tools, or small household items

- Decorative display for home bars or man caves

 

  • Ideal Gift for Any Occasion: Whether it's Father’s Day, Christmas, Birthdays, Anniversaries, Graduations, or Corporate Gifting, this beer and treat case makes a thoughtful and versatile present suitable for anyone and makes it even more special and unique.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Wooden Beer

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
